fix.item: Concurrent uploads claim unique filenames with exclusive create (fopen x) so two requests cannot share one name.
Index rebuild upserts rows first, then deletes orphans (no wipe-first empty window).
Bulk photo delete removes database rows only after confirmed filesystem unlink (or when the file is already gone).
Tools Prewarm and stale-thumb cleanup walk galleries by id cursor in batches (no hard 500-gallery ceiling).
Failed uploads release the empty exclusive-create claim file so corrupt images do not leave 0-byte placeholders.
Thumbnail cleanup preserves uppercase source extensions (e.g. IMG_1.JPG) on case-sensitive filesystems instead of treating their thumbs as orphans.
Unreachable-thumb cleanup still runs when thumbnail_retention_days is 0; only settings-hash retention is skipped.
Frontend adopts/renames legacy ≤1.2.4 thumbs onto the new identity path so large galleries do not briefly show originals after upgrade.
Frontend cold-create budget defaults to max_images_per_gallery (was 6) so one page view can refill thumbs after a cache wipe.
Cleanup keeps adoptable legacy stem.format thumbs while the source still exists.
Legacy thumb adoption is limited to the same settings-hash folder and skips candidates older than the source or ambiguous stems.
Non-blocking flock around frontend thumb creation reduces duplicate concurrent encodes.
Options: frontend_thumb_create_budget (0 = Max images per gallery, capped at 200).

change.item: Thumbnail cache filenames include original extension and a short source identity so replacements and same-stem different-extension files do not reuse a stale cache entry.
Stale thumb cleanup also removes unreachable files inside the current settings-hash folder (legacy names, wrong identity, orphans) with a 24-hour grace period.

note.item: Requires Joomla 6.0+ and PHP 8.3.0+
Existing thumbnails regenerate on next view or Tools Prewarm after update.
After upgrading from 1.2.4 or earlier: run Tools Prewarm, then Cleanup (or leave the weekly Scheduled Task) to free old thumb disk space.
Frontend All Galleries catalog remains soft-capped at 200 rows; Tools cursor covers all galleries.

fix.item: PathHelper rejects equal-base deletes and sibling prefix collisions (galleries2-old); managed gallery delete is unified (folder + thumbs + images + index + gallery).
GalleryTable keeps alias/path on edit; empty URL-safe titles get a dated alias fallback.
Upload allocates a unique filename against disk and DB; ImageProcessor writes atomically via temp+rename; insert failures roll back the file.
NewgalleryModel::save() updates existing rows by id instead of always inserting.
Package installer enables content/editors-xtd plugins only on clean install (not on update).
Module entry functions are guarded with function_exists; PhotosModel thumbnail schema repair is session-guarded; getTableNameForSection uses ?string.
New Gallery Cancel no longer fatals: GalleryController::cancel() redirects without calling FormController getTable() on a missing Gallery model.

Performance: atomic thumbnail writes, per-request create budget with original fallback, deferred thumb cleanup on shutdown, memoized component params, FE image/catalog LIMITs, watermark via imagecopymerge, page-cache clean after gallery mutations.

Modernization: shared GalleryResolver for site/module/content shortcodes (fixes always-true path candidate); SiteAssets + joomla.asset.json via WebAssetManager; mod_devartgallery AbstractModuleDispatcher; namespaced plg_content_devartgallery services provider; component SQL update schemapath for 1.2.4.
Frontend SiteAssets uses explicit registerAndUseStyle/Script (media/com_devartgallery/…) so gallery CSS/JS always load; registry-only useStyle could omit site.css and leave thumbs full-width.

Hardening: transparent PNG watermark opacity preserves alpha (no imagecopymerge box); page cache is not cleared on upload/scan; POST-only CSRF on admin mutations; removed unused single-delete tasks; site media ships only under media/com_devartgallery; removed deprecated imagedestroy().

Performance follow-up: GalleryResolver memoizes base directories via ComponentHelper; FE thumb budget miss sends no-cache headers; admin uploads unrestricted; Tools prewarm + stale-thumb purge; module random order shuffles in PHP (no SQL RAND); JPEG EXIF orientation on upload.
Installer no longer loads GallerySchemaHelper in preflight (old class stayed in memory and blocked new image-column migrations on update).
Module random with limit <= 0 uses the same unbiased ID-shuffle path as positive limits (up to 5000 IDs).
Large-image memory refusal uses language key COM_DEVARTGALLERY_ERROR_IMAGE_MEMORY.
Component admin manifest renamed to devartgallery.xml so Joomla Database checker can read the installed version (fixes empty version / One Problem).

addition.item: Per-image alt text and caption on Photos (admin edit; lightbox / figcaption / accessibility on frontend, module, and content plugin).
plg_task_devartgallery seeds a weekly Scheduled Task on install/update when missing.
Unit tests for ThumbnailHelper settingsHash, galleryThumbKey, getSettings, and path safety.

change.item: plg_task_devartgallery migrated to namespaced Extension\Devartgallery + services/provider.php (Joomla 6 core task-plugin pattern).
ThumbnailHelper shares one thumbRelativePath / path-safety helper between prepareImage and isThumbMissing.

note.item: Requires Joomla 6.0+ and PHP 8.3.0+
After install/update: run Tools → Prewarm thumbnails and confirm the weekly Scheduled Task is enabled.
Tools Prewarm uses gallery/default thumb settings; module overrides are cleaned by retention but not prewarmed.

fix.item: Frontend menu lookup no longer filters by MenuItem::client_id. SiteMenu already loads only site items and does not expose client_id on MenuItem (same fix class as Documents / Events / Business / Video).

note.item: Requires Joomla 6.0+ and PHP 8.3.0+

change.item: Replaced deprecated AbstractView::get() with direct model calls in all HtmlView classes (Joomla 7.0 removal).
Replaced Table::getDbo() with getDatabase(); Factory::getCache() with CacheControllerFactoryInterface; Factory::getDate() with CMS Date.
Models use Factory::getApplication()->getInput() instead of public $app->input.

fix.item: Admin controllers keep BaseController $this->input / $this->app (getInput/getApplication are not BaseController methods on Joomla 6).
Fixes Scan Existing Photos and Settings save fatals from an incorrect controller API migration.

note.item: Forward-compatibility maintenance for Joomla 7/8 readiness.
Requires Joomla 6.0+ and PHP 8.3.0+

addition.item: Module layout Galleries (folder grid): lists published active galleries as folder icon + title, linking to the component gallery page.
Frontend menu type All Galleries (view=galleries) as folder catalog and SEF routing parent for gallery links.
Settings: All Galleries menu item (canonical_menu_item) to bind the listing Itemid for module and component gallery URLs.

change.item: Galleries folder grid: SEF-route via exact gallery menu or All Galleries listing menu; otherwise raw component URL so Home Itemid cannot drop the gallery id.

note.item: Create a menu item of type All Galleries, then select it in Settings → All Galleries menu item.
Gallery picker, thumbnail overrides, and popup options are hidden for the module Galleries layout.
Requires Joomla 6.0+ and PHP 8.3.0+

addition.item: Administrator Tools submenu and hub (Settings and Options cards, shared Galleries Index header banner).
Dedicated Settings screen: Frontend Display and Thumbnail Cache (aspect ratio, popup caption/counter, hover zoom/rise/color overlay with colour and opacity, drop shadow, border).
Tools action to clean the thumbnail cache; thumbnails regenerate on demand.
Tools card that opens Module Manager filtered to mod_devartgallery.
Module gallery field uses Joomla ModalSelect (portable path, not database ID).
Module Default grid inherits Settings with Use Global overrides; Masonry disabled when Thumbnail Cache is Fixed size.
Module Slider layout: single row, Settings thumb size, arrows, gap, autoplay (ms), loop, hover overlay.
Module Showcase panels layout: 3–6 visible panels, narrow/wide hover expand, active-only colour, optional gap.
Module Stage layout: main image + thumb strip, arrows, loop.
Module optional Thumbnail Mode / Width / Height override (separate thumb cache hash per size).
Module Full width option and Gallery Display tab.
Slider and Stage dedicated image limits (default 20, max 48).
Options Paths: Joomla Media folder picker for Legacy and Active base folders.
Full language packs regenerated for all supported locales (machine translation; Greek curated).

change.item: Dashboard Options card opens the Tools hub.
Joomla Options keep Paths & Migration, Upload Processing, Thumbnail Format/Quality/Retention/Cleanup, Uninstall, and Permissions.
Frontend Display and Thumbnail Cache controls moved from Options into Settings.
Aspect ratio applies only when Thumbnail Cache is Off.
Masonry requires Thumbnail Mode Width only; Fixed size forces Normal grid (module override can enable Width only for Masonry).
Module Image Limit default is 100 (minimum 1); legacy 0 still caps at 200.
Slider arrows are white on a black background for contrast.
Options Media picker values (local-images:/…) are normalised to portable images/… paths.
Module Thumbnail Mode Use Global fully inherits Settings (ignores leftover width/height overrides).
Cleaned legacy menu links so SEF URLs are /alias instead of /alias?gallery_id=N.

note.item: Galleries stay layout-agnostic; no component template packs. Module owns extra presentation modes; shortcodes and menu galleries stay simple.
Settings and Options both store values in component params.
Requires Joomla 6.0+ and PHP 8.3.0+

addition.item: Added Thumbnail Mode Width only (proportional height) for masonry-friendly thumbnail cache.

change.item: Thumbnail Mode options simplified to Fixed size (width + height) and Width only.
Thumbnail Mode field is shown above width/height; Height is hidden in Width only mode.
Legacy Fit mode maps to Fixed size (crop).
Thumbnail HTML dimensions now use the actual generated file size.
Existing galleries inherit Component Options again so Options changes affect the frontend; thumbnail media cache is cleared once during that repair.
Fixed gallery menu items baking frontend_mode=normal and blocking Options Masonry on component gallery pages.
Menu Display fields now Use Global by default; empty values inherit Component Options.

note.item: Recommended for masonry layouts with thumbnail cache enabled.
Changing thumbnail mode regenerates a new cache folder automatically.
After update, set Options Frontend Mode to Masonry and Thumbnail Mode to Width only.
Requires Joomla 6.0+ and PHP 8.3.0+

fix.item: Fixed Active gallery hub failing to open for upload, scan, and settings when opened through the Galleries list or index_id route.
Fixed InvalidArgumentException in managed gallery materialization (ParameterType::INTEGER instead of PDO::PARAM_INT).
Fixed Active galleries incorrectly shown as Legacy read-only when materialization failed.
Fixed upload and Scan Existing Photos returning No Gallery Selected or Invalid request when the managed gallery id was not posted correctly.
Fixed legacy gallery photo pagination dropping index_id and id from page links.
Fixed Joomla 6 Folder::files() signature misuse causing count(): true given fatal errors on legacy gallery photo lists.
Fixed materialization on upgraded sites with legacy required relative_path column.
Fixed empty gallery alias fallback for upload filenames on upgraded managed galleries.
Galleries Index no longer opens gallery edit links; use the Galleries view instead.

note.item: Recommended update for all 1.1.3 installations, especially when Active galleries open read-only or upload/scan fails.
After update, run Rebuild Active Index once if galleries were previously unlinked.
Requires Joomla 6.0+ and PHP 8.3.0+

fix.item: Follow-up hotfix for sites that updated to an early 1.1.2 build before schema and Active index rebuild fixes were complete.
Consolidates galleries/index schema migration hardening and Active index rebuild fixes from late 1.1.2 builds.
Active index rebuild now indexes first-level folders on disk even when managed gallery rows cannot be created yet.
Improved Active directory path resolution with multiple filesystem candidates and clearer zero-result diagnostics.

note.item: Recommended update for all 1.1.2 installations, especially when Active index rebuild returns 0 galleries despite existing folders.
After update, run Rebuild Active Index once from Galleries Index.
Requires Joomla 6.0+ and PHP 8.3.0+

fix.item: Added installer migration for the missing galleries.description column on upgraded or reinstall-over-existing-table sites.
Fixed administrator Galleries view SQL error: Unknown column g.description in SELECT.
Hardened schema migration with preflight execution and fallback ALTER statements.
Fixed Active/Legacy index rebuild failures on sites with legacy galleries or index table schemas.

note.item: Hotfix release. No other functional changes.
Requires Joomla 6.0+ and PHP 8.3.0+

addition.item: Added packaged language packs for cs-CZ, nl-NL, pl-PL, ru-RU, uk-UA, ja-JP, tr-TR, and zh-CN.

change.item: Administrator Dashboard rebuilt with Slider-style action cards for New Gallery, Galleries, and Options.
Galleries Index remains as a secondary action above the existing dashboard statistics and info panels.
Language generator uses Argos offline translation with strict printf placeholder protection.

note.item: Admin UI polish and translations. No database schema changes.
Requires Joomla 6.0+ and PHP 8.3.0+

addition.item: Packaged language packs for el-GR, fr-FR, de-DE, es-ES, it-IT, and pt-PT.
Gallery hub with Overview, Photos, and Settings tabs for active galleries.
Package-only GitHub update channel at repository root (pkg_devartgallery).

change.item: Administrator Galleries, Index, and Dashboard rebuilt to match DevArt Widgets responsive pattern.
Simplified Galleries list; path/shortcode/integration details moved into Overview.
Legacy galleries open read-only in the hub.
Module image limit default is 24; limit 0 applies a safety cap of 200 (max 500).
Content plugin hard-caps rendered images at 60 for large legacy folders.
Rate-limited on-demand thumbnail cache cleanup during frontend rendering.

fix.item: Security and ACL hardening for admin mutations, custom actions with core fallbacks, and path checks.
Enforced max_images_per_gallery on uploads and scan-existing imports.
Upload dimension and pixel-count validation.
Replaced GLOB_BRACE folder scans with portable Folder::files().
Admin pagination fixed with plain GET links; site SEF router for Gallery menu items.
Hardened legacy read-only enforcement when POST gallery_id is used without query context.
JED Checker language quoting; removed duplicate package language files.
Localized remaining raw English upload failure messages.
Replaced Factory::getDbo() in admin controllers with DatabaseDriver from the DI container.
Removed obsolete imagedestroy() calls; added declare(strict_types=1) to module and content plugin.

note.item: Public minor release after baseline 1.0.11. Intermediate local builds are not published separately.
Requires Joomla 6.0+ and PHP 8.3.0+
Install and update only through pkg_devartgallery.

fix.item: Fixed New Gallery model architecture by switching NewgalleryModel to Joomla AdminModel form workflow.
Fixed New Gallery save validation workflow.
Fixed Joomla toolbar Back/Cancel button by using adminForm-compatible markup and gallery.cancel task.
Added missing COM_DEVARTGALLERY_ALIAS language string.

addition.item: Added per-gallery thumbnail cache settings with default values from component Options.
Added frontend on-demand thumbnail generation for active and legacy galleries.
Added thumbnail creation during new gallery/photo uploads from the administrator.
Added versioned thumbnail folders per gallery and per thumbnail setting hash.
Added staged thumbnail cleanup settings for old cache versions.

change.item: Gallery grid images now use lightweight generated thumbnails when available, while popup/full image links continue to use the optimized original image.
Existing active and legacy galleries do not generate thumbnails during installation/update; thumbnails are created only when the gallery is requested.
Changing thumbnail settings for one gallery clears only that gallery thumbnail cache.

note.item: No mass thumbnail regeneration is performed during update.
Thumbnail cache path: media/com_devartgallery/thumbs/gallery-{id}/{settings-hash}/.
No redesign. No frontend shortcode, module, content plugin, editor button, or legacy indexing logic changes in the hotfix portion of this release.

fix.item: Fixed critical Joomla 6 administrator fatal error in New Gallery workflow caused by incorrect model architecture.
Fixed New Gallery model to use proper Joomla AdminModel form workflow.
Fixed broken gallery save workflow for newly created galleries.
Fixed broken administrator Back / Cancel toolbar behavior in New Gallery view.
Fixed missing administrator language string COM_DEVARTGALLERY_ALIAS.

change.item: Improved Joomla 6 administrator form compatibility for gallery creation workflow.
Improved production stability for administrator gallery management.
Improved reliability of New Gallery create/save operations.

note.item: Critical production hotfix release.
Recommended update for all DevArt Gallery v1.0.9 installations.
No frontend behavior changes or feature modifications in this release.

fix.item: Fixed component configuration parameter handling when Joomla stores component params in nested JSON format.
Fixed Dashboard showing fallback or incorrect gallery paths instead of configured values.
Fixed Legacy Archive Directory display inconsistencies in the administrator dashboard.
Fixed Active Gallery Directory display inconsistencies in the administrator dashboard.
Fixed Legacy Index rebuild using incorrect directory values in specific installations.
Fixed Active Index rebuild using incorrect directory values in specific installations.
Fixed indexing behavior when configuration values were correctly saved but incorrectly read by internal component logic.
Fixed component options path handling for Legacy Archive Directory.
Fixed component options path handling for Active Gallery Directory.
Fixed legacy index rebuild using incorrect base directory when custom path was configured.
Fixed active gallery operations using fallback paths in some workflows.

change.item: Improved compatibility with different Joomla component parameter storage behaviors.
Improved dashboard configuration accuracy across installations.
Improved gallery indexing reliability for production environments.
Improved migration safety for legacy gallery deployments.
Improved internal configuration loading consistency.
Improved path consistency across Dashboard, Galleries, New Gallery, Manage Photos, Scan Existing Photos, delete safety checks and frontend shortcode resolving.

note.item: This release focuses on configuration reliability, indexing stability and production consistency.
Recommended update for all previous DevArt Gallery releases.

First production release for Joomla 6 with active managed galleries, legacy gallery indexing, content plugin, editor button plugin, frontend module, popup viewer, strict filename policy, ACL and Keep Data on Uninstall option.

fix.item: Fixed Legacy Archive Directory custom path handling when changed from default values.
Fixed Active Gallery Directory custom path handling when changed from default values.
Fixed dashboard directory cards showing incorrect default paths after configuration changes.
Fixed Legacy Index rebuild ignoring custom Legacy Archive Directory settings.
Fixed Active Index rebuild ignoring custom Active Gallery Directory settings.
Fixed legacy indexing conflicts when Legacy Archive Directory includes the Active Gallery Directory.

change.item: Improved path normalization and component parameter loading consistency.
Improved migration safety when legacy galleries are indexed from broader directories.
Improved dashboard accuracy for custom gallery path deployments.
Improved Joomla Update metadata consistency for production releases.

note.item: This release focused on custom path handling, indexing reliability and migration safety.
Recommended update for users of earlier initial releases.

addition.item: Added full Joomla 6 native DevArt Image Gallery component with modern MVC architecture.
Added active managed gallery system.
Added legacy gallery indexing with read-only compatibility support.
Added portable path-based shortcode support for legacy and active galleries.
Added frontend gallery display module.
Added content plugin for article gallery rendering.
Added editor button for easy gallery shortcode insertion.
Added popup image viewer support.
Added responsive frontend gallery layouts.
Added Normal Grid and Masonry frontend display modes.
Added gallery management interface.
Added Manage Photos interface with pagination.
Added Scan Existing Photos support.
Added automatic image indexing system.
Added support for JPG, PNG and WEBP image uploads.
Added automatic image optimization workflow.
Added strict filename sanitization policy.
Added optional watermark support per gallery.
Added Joomla menu item integration for direct gallery frontend pages.
Added Joomla ACL permissions support.
Added Keep Data on Uninstall option.

change.item: Gallery architecture designed specifically for Joomla 6 and PHP 8.3+.
Legacy gallery compatibility implemented without modifying historical gallery folders.
Frontend rendering kept lightweight to minimize template conflicts.
CSS and JavaScript namespaced for safer third-party compatibility.
Manage Photos optimized with pagination for larger galleries.
Gallery indexing optimized for controlled batch operations.
Modern service provider and MVCComponent architecture used throughout.

note.item: Initial public release of DevArt Gallery for Joomla 6.
Designed for editorial, news and high-traffic Joomla websites.
Always test on a staging environment before production deployment.
